result_assessed: 3-point MACE (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke), hazard ratio, effect of assignment (ITT)

D1_randomisation.why: Central IWRS randomisation 1:1 (sequence and concealment via the system); baseline balance not held (1.3 = NI, which RoB 2 allows at low).

witnesses.span: Randomization was performed using an interactive web response system on the same day as the screening visit or up to 3 weeks afterwards.

D2_deviations_assignment.why: Blinded (visually identical tablets), but the analysis population for MACE is not bound: the protocol's FAS text sits in a letter-spaced PDF text layer that does not render (2.6 = NI).

witnesses.span: Blinding of investigational product was maintained through using visually identical oral semaglutide and placebo tablets, regardless of dose level, in identical packaging.

D3_missing_outcome_data.why: Registry participant flow (rendered from V1.1): completed 4755/4825 vs 4740/4826 (98.5% vs 98.2%); not completed 70 vs 86 -- lost to follow-up 43 vs 51, withdrew 27 vs 34: small and balanced. This is TRIAL COMPLETION, not a vital-status figure (the results paper, which would give vital status, is not held) -- weigh accordingly.

D4_outcome_measurement.why: Central adjudication by a masked external committee.

witnesses.span: Potential CV and kidney outcome events, along with selected AEs, underwent central adjudication by a masked external event adjudica- tion committee,

D5_selection_of_reported_result.why: The 2023 design paper (before the 2025 results) fixes 3-point MACE as the primary outcome.

witnesses.span: The primary trial outcome is time from randomization (week 0) to first occurrence of adjudication-confirmed MACE (a composite outcome consisting of CV death, nonfatal MI or nonfatal stroke).

overall.rule: RoB 2 algorithm on the proposals; not computed when any domain lacks evidence
